title: Soul Feast #80: Who’s Driving Your Chariot? Krishna & The Great Battle – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
excerpt: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
bodyHtml:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE

In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav continues his personal experiences series by turning to a frequency of wisdom that has stayed close to his heart: Krishna. Drawing a familiar distinction between institutionalized religion and living spiritual truth, Gary makes clear this isn’t about Hinduism as dogma – it’s about the Soul’s intention pulsing at its center. He traces his encounter with the Mahabharata and its heart, the Bhagavad Gita, unpacking the epic allegory of two warring families as something far more intimate: the Great Battle between love and fear being fought within each of us, every moment.

Gary walks through the pivotal scene in which Arjuna – the greatest warrior in the Earth School – finds his physical body trembling before battle, and Krishna halts the chariot to provide a non-physical perspective. The two armies are not external families – they represent the loving and frightened parts of your own personality. The Responsible Choice of who drives your chariot is the choice that defines your life and creates your future.

Authentic Power is not found in armies, wealth, or external power – it is found in the alignment of your personality with your Soul, choosing love over fear, moment by moment, in the Earth School.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:00) — Two Worlds, One Choice: Gary opens with the invitation anchoring this series: the choice between the new multisensory consciousness – gratitude, patience, and awe – and the old world of external power defined by anger, worry, and despair.
  • (03:05) — The Heart of Hinduism: Gary shares how the Mahabharata opened him to living spiritual wisdom –  and how its heart, the Bhagavad Gita, distills everything into one searing question: love or fear?
  • (06:30) — Arjuna’s Responsible Choice: The greatest warrior in the Earth School chooses Krishna as his chariot driver over all the armies in the world. Gary unpacks what that choice means – and why the Kaurava leader’s delight in gaining the armies (external power) is itself the lesson.
  • (09:44) — The Greatest Battle Is Inside You: The two warring families represent the loving and frightened parts of your personality. The battle between them is the curriculum every awakening human being is living right now.
  • (13:06) — Authentic Power Requires Your Total Involvement: Multisensory perception alone does not create Authentic Power – commitment, courage, compassion, and conscious action do. You cannot opt out. You volunteered.
  • (20:56) — Living it Consciously: Gary shares how he and Linda Francis listened to the Bhagavad Gita together in Spiritual Partnership, and how even after her Soul’s transition, they continue to co-create. He carries Krishna’s words not as philosophy, but as lived experience.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of the great battle in your own life – not on any battlefield, but in a choice you keep deferring, a frightened part of yourself you keep handing the reins to. Arjuna, the greatest warrior in the world, froze. And yet he chose Krishna. Who are you choosing as your chariot driver? What would it look like, just today, to let love drive?
